seo.title: seoCompetitionsTitle
seo.minimum_data: None beyond the mart's own browsable filter (a non-blank display_group, already applied in mart_competition_index) — every competition in competition_index.json renders. Row content is not yet a link (see url_permanence_note): outbound is empty until #47 ships.
seo.url_permanence_note: The URL is permanent; the CONTENT is not yet fully linked. Rows are inert — no anchor, matching the site's standing no-dead-links convention — because #47 (the competition hub each row would link to) is not built. inbound_hub is honestly "none": the SiteHeader nav links here sitewide, but that is persistent chrome, not a dedicated content hub, matching the home page's own spec (also "none") despite being nav-linked from everywhere too.
